top_signals.title: Oil’s safety net is fraying as Saudi Arabia races to restart a key pipeline
top_signals.summary: Analysts warn oil prices could rally sharply if the pipeline remains offline beyond an estimated five-to-seven-day inventory cushion.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: 10-year Treasury yield rises to highest since 2007 as Fed rate-hike expectations rise
top_signals.summary: The sell-off in U.S. government debt is deepening as investors increasingly price in an interest rate hike this week.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
